label: run131 load resource rrs
definition: run129 (CC-only DAM offer curve + energy/reserve co-opt) plus a measured load-resource reserve credit: the cleared RRS-UFR (under-frequency-relay responsive reserve, by ERCOT protocol provided only by Load Resources; ~0.8-0.9 GW) is credited into the co-opt reserve balance by lowering its RHS, since the LP otherwise counts only thermal headroom + storage and so prices an ORDC scarcity adder in non-scarce hours. KEEPER vs run129: cuts monthly LMP MAE toward actual (2024 13.1->10.5, 2025 17.1->11.3; 2025 avg 49.5->43.7 vs 32.5 actual) and pulls the 2024/2025 >$200 tail toward actual (2024 82->49 vs 53; 2025 84->60 vs 31) while per-class TWh are unchanged (DAM-BASE ~ 0 every class/year, so the 12/18 volume keeper and ST_GAS/CT hold exactly). 2023 is uncredited here only because the 2023 as_up_mw series was not built — the NP3-911 2-Day feed begins 2023-12-10, but full-year 2023 AS data is in the repo (60-Day DAM Disclosure: Gen Resource Data, Load Resource AS Offers, DAMASAGGNP419, ASPLANNP433), so 2023 can be credited from those — its LMP and the 151/88 scarcity tail are untouched in this run. Measured (no markup); 2025 still runs ~$11 hot (residual co-opt overshoot, not fixable by lowering CT/ST below the measured curve).
